Coverage of DTP Booster Doses

Source: R/vaccination_inputs.R
backfill_booster_coverage.Rd

WHO booster coverage (the 4th to 6th diphtheria-containing doses) only starts in 2018. Before the first year with data, each booster's coverage is taken as the same share of DTP3 coverage as in its first years with data (the mean over up to three years), from `booster_since` on, and zero before that. This keeps a booster that was already routine in 2018 for the earlier cohorts that serosurveys sample. Where a booster was introduced recently, set `booster_since` to its introduction year, or give coverage directly with `custom_routine_vaccination`.

Usage

backfill_booster_coverage(routine_coverage, years, booster_since = 1980)

Arguments

routine_coverage

Matrix from [routine_dose_coverage()] (proportions; doses 1 to 3 then the boosters).

years

Model years.

booster_since

First year in which boosters can be given before their coverage data start.

Value

`routine_coverage` with booster coverage filled in before its data, and no dose above the one before it.
